summary: Duplicate town shops consume independently, but the 2x multiplier applies only to single-product shops. BAKERY and BRUNCH_SPOT consume one EGG per shop tick, not two, and shops unlock every 3 days by default rather than nightly.

egg.interpretation: A 37+ EGG/day town is possible only after substantially more shop unlocks and an EGG-heavy realized composition; it is not produced by a 2x BAKERY/BRUNCH multiplier and cannot occur by day 8 under the default 3-day unlock cadence.

scope: Research semantics only. No production runtime, defaults, configuration, archive, opponent, simulation, or Kaggle mutation. QUILL #4 RNG steering remains a separate owner lane.
